description_en: Removes an input source from a production studio
name: DeleteCasterVideoResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value from the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, find the ID on the Cloud Production Studio page. The navigation path is ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio.

You can find the ID of the production studio in the Instance ID/Name column
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. If you added the video resource by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848020.html operation, use the ResourceId value from the response
